title: rent float per job and its return
result: About 1.97M lamports (0.00197 SOL) of channel rent is fronted per completed job and returned in full by one batched reclaim transaction.
method: fee payer balance read from chain at each step
note: The balance before reclaim also includes the open escrow of the B2 channel started in between. The first-job float includes two 5,000 lamport signature fees.
